message.content:
The vulnerability is an out-of-bounds array access.  

`htype` is a `uint8_t` derived from the low byte of `type`, so it can be 0–255.  
The `mandatory_handlers` array has only 255 elements (indices 0–254).  
If `htype == 255`, then `mandatory_handlers[255]` is out of bounds.  

The check `if (htype < 0x80)` only filters values below 128, so values 128–255 reach the array access.  
The array size should be 256 to safely index with any `uint8_t`.  

The bug is introduced at the array declaration (line 2), because the size is too small for the possible index range.  

Answer: 2
